==Quest information==
===Objectives===
*Travel through the [[Sage Lands]] and await the [[druid]]s at the base of the waterfall.

===Reward===
* 500 [[Experience]]
* 100 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)

==Walkthrough==
[[Image:Wisdom of the Druid meeting.jpg|thumb]]
[[Emote|Kneel]] at the [[Statue of Dwayna]] in Druid's Overlook.  She will appear and you can take the quest.

It's preferable to start out from [[The Wilds (outpost)|The Wilds]].  The path is shorter and pretty much straight.  From [[Druid's Overlook]] you will have to take a significant detour to the west when your path to the north is blocked; a detour that will practically take you to The Wilds doorstep.

Once at the spot where the quest marker leads you, you will be attacked by successive groups of [[Maguuma Spider]]s (x2, x2, x3, then x3).  The Druids will then appear after the spiders are defeated. Watch their ritual and talk to the Ancient Druid Spirit when they are finished.

==Dialogue==

===Initial dialogue===
'''Avatar of Dwayna'''
:''"Child, Dwayna senses within you the impatience that all too often plagues the mortal mind. She now offers you an opportunity to glimpse a deeper serenity to which you may aspire. The druids of Maguuma, holy beings who surrendered their mortal flesh to become one with the jungle, will soon gather beneath a '''waterfall''' not far from here. Search through the '''Sage Lands''' for their meeting place and await them there."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I submit to the wisdom of Dwayna.
| decline = Forgive me. I have no time for this.
| ask = I have little more to tell you about this. Enlightenment will come from experience, not from words. Search the '''Sage Lands''' for the '''waterfall''' where the druids will meet and await them there.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
'''Ancient Druid Spirit'''
:''"It is not often that we allow mortals to witness our rituals, but we see in you the seeds of the divine.  To be divine is to realize that we are all one.  That the self is an illusion.  Through this do you understand your own immortality.  Through this are you freed from the illusions of the flesh.''

:''Do not rush your understanding of these mysteries.  Allow them to take root and mature gradually within you as the seedling in the soil."''

==Notes==
*Be wary of going up the small hill to where the Maguuma Spider waves spawn, because there are several more spider spawns hiding in the trees, and [[Moss Scarab]]s hidden in the ground.
*The [[Rider]] boss you need to kill for [[Eye For Profit]] is in the same spot, and can be killed at the same time regardless of whether you have spoken to [[Grahm]].
